detailed_descriptions.en: Still traumatized by the catastrophic destruction of the Second Great Collapse, Voidborn cling to life aboard what megastations still survive among the Shattered Systems. Now, threatened by an otherworldly calamity known simply as The Veil, the Samarin Empire crumbles under its ceaseless advance. Take the role of an Astral, an immortal starship pilot sent to investigate the collapse of the Samarin Empire. A roguelite campaign that takes you from the edge of the empire, into its crumbling heart, and into The Veil. More than a dozen regions to explore and secret stargates leading to lost pockets of space. Base defense and building mechanics. 4 total enemy factions to battle against. Including: pirates, legions of traitors, and cultists. Each with their own set of ships and tactics. Large scale fleet battles as you fight alongside the remnants of the Samarin loyalists. Over 80 weapons and ship abilities. Plenty of other quests and side quests. Hordes of pirates, a legion of traitors, and an armada of cultists want you dead. Embark on expeditions throughout the ruined Samarin Empire to raid your enemies for resources. Craft a variety of defensive structures and upgrade your base to hold off waves of enemies. Every region of the empire has unique challenges, quests, and loot. Collect as much as you can and extract without dying to build your arsenal. Countless combinations of weapons and abilities await. Open a gateway into a corrupted realm that is spewing abominations into our dimension. Delve deep, defeat the terrors within, uncover its secrets, and end this apocalypse.
